name: Brewer Fountain
parts: pedestal with four seated figures (Neptune, Amphitrite, Acis, Galatea)
style: 1868 Lienard bronze fountain cast in Paris, dark olive bronze with verdigris streaks, wet granite basin
summary: Brewer Fountain, 6.7 m bronze tiered fountain in a 12 m granite basin: four seated figures, two bowls and a top spout.
